units: 1 Blender unit = 1 stud, Z-up in Blender; FBX axis_forward -Z, axis_up Y, scale 1.0 (Roblox Y-up). Blender +Y = Roblox -Z.
placement: All meshes are in WORLD coordinates (hole frame already applied). Place the FBX root at CFrame.new(0,0,0). Hole root CFrame = CFrame.new(world_offset) * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(world_yaw), 0).

holes.name: Lantern Quay
holes.gimmick: Bank shot: a snow-capped boulder's 45-degree face turns the ball east onto an offset green

holes.name: Snowpuff Burrows
holes.gimmick: Tunnel choice: three snow burrows - short and tight (left), a dead end that rolls the ball back (middle), long and safe (right)

holes.name: Glimmer Crossing
holes.gimmick: Rail-less glowing ice plank straight over the open-sky Glimmer Gap (risky) or the railed ice bridge to the right (safe); a ball in the gap respawns at the plank entry (+1)

holes.name: Glissade
holes.gimmick: Ice felt: a glassy low-friction strip where the ball barely slows; pace control into a snow-felt green

holes.name: Geyser Hop
holes.gimmick: Geyser lift: a basalt platform rides a steam column up 4 studs to the upper green, pauses, and sinks back; roll on while it is down

moving_parts.mesh_pose: blockers at t=0 pose (phase); mesh origin = pivot; motion per holes.json
moving_parts.sweep_note: convex hull of sampled blocker poses over the full range (swing/rotate hulls overstate the true swept band slightly)

holes.name: Palm Lagoon
holes.gimmick: Side-slope green: a snow-felt shelf tilted toward a turquoise hot-spring pool (hazard; misses respawn beside it)

holes.name: Mogul Meadow
holes.gimmick: Rolling dips: four snow moguls built from opposing planar slopes; pace the ball over the humps

holes.name: Coral Pinball
holes.gimmick: Bumper field: static flat-faced coral-ice bumpers at set angles bounce the ball down the reef toward the cup

holes.name: Conch Shortcut
holes.gimmick: Teleport: sink the ball into a giant coral-ice conch at the end of a rail-less reef spit and it shoots out of a second shell by the green, or play the long reef route round the lagoon

holes.name: Bobsled Bend
holes.gimmick: Half-pipe: an S-bend bobsled channel with banked felt walls; ride high to carry the bend

holes.name: Floe Drift
